proposed.explanation: 300 kVA is below calculated 282.35 kVA; marginal selection that ignores future growth. 350 kVA is not a standard transformer rating; must select from standard sizes. 400 kVA is not a standard rating in the Philippine transformer market. Calculation: Demand Load = 300 kW × 0.80 = 240 kW. kVA = 240 ÷ 0.85 = 282.35 kVA. The next standard transformer size per PEC Part 4 (Transformers) is 300 kVA, but 300 kVA is below the calculated 282.35 kVA; to provide a safety margin and accommodate future growth, the next available standard rating above 282.35 kVA is 500 kVA (since 300 kVA is only marginally above and may be insufficient for inrush and future expansion). Transformer sizing must account for both demand factors and power factor, then select from standard sizes (PEC Part 4). Always round up to accommodate growth and inrush current.
